name: K-Scale K-Bot
summary: K-Bot was an open-source humanoid for developers from K-Scale Labs in Palo Alto. It stood about 1.4 m tall and weighed 34 kg. K-Scale canceled pre-orders and laid off most staff in November 2025 after failing to raise funding, and released its designs under open licenses.
sensors: RGB camera, stereo vision, ultra-wide camera, far-field microphones, stereo speakers.
highlights: Interesting Engineering reported a starting price of $10,999 before the shutdown.
Hardware released under CERN-OHL-S-2.0 and software under MIT after the shutdown.
caveats: Discontinued: K-Scale canceled all pre-orders and refunded deposits in November 2025.
Only a small number of Founder's Edition units are reported to have shipped.
